description: design has a CONCRETE rule for C-002 (antibiotics / 5-drug-limit) but the rule is the OPPOSITE of the obligation (allows unlimited drugs, antibiotics skip chief-physician review). A test (TC-N-099) is aligned with the REVERSED rule (asserts antibiotics can be directly approved), so has_test_alignment would be true — yet the rule contradicts gold C-002. Must be scored LOW via the Phase 2.5 contradiction check (code-side clamp ≤1), not by test alignment.

C-002.rationale: design 明确与 gold 相反(允许任意数量/抗生素跳过审核)且配了 TC-N-099 对齐反向规则→靠 contradiction check 代码侧强制 clamp ≤1，而非靠 test alignment

F-006.rationale: 处方主流程未受影响（其他审核规则仍在）
